centrifugal_pump.description: This project type involves the design, fabrication, and supply of horizontal centrifugal pumps, including associated calculations and specifications, as defined by project requirements and procedures.

required_docs.title: Document Register
required_docs.reason: The Document Register is a key planning and control document to record all documents that will be produced on a project. It is developed as part of project planning and maintained throughout the project by the respective disciplines. (filled_register_example Commentary)

required_docs.title: Project Execution Plan
required_docs.reason: This document is part of Project Administration (WBS 0-2) and outlines the plan for project execution. (filled_register_example Document Register)

required_docs.title: Project Schedule
required_docs.reason: This document is part of Planning (WBS 0-3) and provides the project schedule, identifying the total number of documents (deliverables) required. (filled_register_example Document Register, Commentary)

required_docs.title: Process Design Criteria
required_docs.reason: The purpose of this document is to record the owner’s process requirements for the project and present a summary of the process design criteria and contractual requirements for the project team. (1-PRC-0001_process_design_criteria)

required_docs.title: Process Calculations
required_docs.reason: These calculations are part of Process Technology (WBS 1) and provide foundational process data derived from the Process Design Criteria. (filled_register_example Document Register, 1-PRC-0001_process_design_criteria)

required_docs.title: Pump Calculation Procedure
required_docs.reason: This procedure describes how project personnel will prepare pump calculations to provide a clear, checkable, technically adequate record of pump sizing. (4-PRC-0007_pump_calculation_procedure)

required_docs.title: Pump Calculations
required_docs.reason: These calculations are prepared by the Hydraulic Engineer to provide a clear, checkable, technically adequate record of pump sizing, following the Pump Calculation Procedure. (filled_register_example Document Register, 4-PRC-0007_pump_calculation_procedure)

required_docs.title: Pump Data Sheets
required_docs.reason: Pump Data Sheets detail the process requirements for individual pumps and are used by the Requisition Originator to prepare requisitions for purchase enquiry/order. (filled_register_example Document Register, 4-SPC-0002_centrifugal_pump_spec, 4-PRC-0007_pump_calculation_procedure)

required_docs.title: Horizontal Centrifugal Pumps
required_docs.reason: This specification defines the general requirements for the design, fabrication and supply of horizontal centrifugal pumps, referencing individual Pump Data Sheets for process requirements. (filled_register_example Document Register, 4-SPC-0002_centrifugal_pump_spec)

required_docs.title: General Equipment Requirements
required_docs.reason: This document defines general equipment requirements, applicable when special service conditions exist, such as corrosive fluids. (Prompt instruction for corrosive_fluid risk flag)

required_docs.title: Equipment Bid Tabulations
required_docs.reason: This document is used to tabulate and compare bids for equipment, based on calculations, data sheets, and specifications. (filled_register_example Document Register)

risk_flags.description: Special service conditions requiring specific material selection for pump components.
risk_flags.warning: Corrosive fluid service requires careful material selection for pump wet end, power end, mechanical seal, and impellers, and may impact equipment design and cost. Ensure `4-SPC-0001` is thoroughly reviewed.
risk_flags.rag_query: What are the material selection requirements for corrosive fluid service for pump components like wet end, power end, mechanical seal, and impellers, as per Chemetics specifications and general plant design requirements?

risk_flags.description: Project involves high operating pressures, requiring specific design considerations for pump connections and pressure testing.
risk_flags.warning: High operating pressures require careful design of pump suction and discharge connections, and may necessitate specialized components or testing. Verify pressure ratings and design standards like DIN PN10.
risk_flags.rag_query: What are the design and testing requirements for high-pressure pump applications, including flange standards (e.g., DIN PN10) and pressure ratings, as per project design criteria and equipment specifications?

centrifugal_pump.scheduling_notes: The workflow begins with foundational project documents such as the Document Register (0-LST-0001), Project Execution Plan (0-PRC-2003), and Project Schedule (0-DAT-3001.0). The Process Design Criteria (1-PRC-0001) is a critical early deliverable, establishing project process requirements and feeding into subsequent process and equipment design. Process Calculations (1-CAL-XXXX) follow, providing necessary data for equipment design. The Pump Calculation Procedure (4-PRC-0007) guides the Mechanical Engineer in performing Pump Calculations (4-CAL-0001). These calculations, along with the Process Design Criteria, are used to create Pump Data Sheets (4-DST-XXXX). The Horizontal Centrifugal Pumps specification (4-SPC-0002) is then developed, referencing the data sheets. Finally, Equipment Bid Tabulations (4-TAB-XXXX) are prepared based on the completed specifications and data. The General Equipment Requirements (4-SPC-0001) is a standing document that may be referenced throughout the equipment design phase, especially when specific risk flags are triggered.
